## Design note

The old workhorse still in service: a long, soft, boxy V8 sedan that leans, floats and squats like a boat, with drum rear brakes that fade after a few hard stops. It has the low-end shove to close on ordinary traffic and nothing for a sports car beyond 120 km/h — but it is a full-length steel frame on wheels, and nobody wants it in their door.

## How this car breaks

Body-on-frame: a perimeter steel frame runs bumper to bumper under a separate body, with steel bumpers and a bolted push bar, so it shrugs off shunts that fold a modern unibody. The late-80s cabin is the weak point — thin pillars, no door intrusion structure to speak of — so hits above the frame rail reach the occupants, and the long overhangs swing wide in a spin.

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| roll | 931 | 0.82 | 760 |
| pitch | 4870 | 0.95 | 4630 |

Frontal area A = 0.85·W·H = 2.41 m²; Cd = 0.40 → **CdA = 1.013 m²** + 0.05 m² (lightbar/push bar). Lift Cl·A front/rear = +0.12 / +0.14 m² (class-typical; positive = lift). No add-on aero (`aero_downforce_coeffs` = 0, mods add it).

## Engine

5.7 L OHV 16-valve V8, throttle-body injection, police package (performance cam, dual exhaust, high-flow intake). Class-typical late-80s 5.7 L throttle-body police V8 (~27 kW/L, ~155 kW at 4000 rpm, ~412 N·m at 2800) per fleet spec-class data and period road tests: all low-end torque, nothing above 4500 rpm.

Peak **155 kW @ 4000 rpm**, **412 N·m @ 2800 rpm**. Idle 600 / redline 5000 / limiter 5200 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.26 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 12% of peak torque = 49 N·m. Power-to-weight 83 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

4-speed automatic with overdrive and lock-up torque converter, clutch-type rear LSD (police option) on a coil-sprung live axle. Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: clutch LSD, preload 60 N·m, power ramp 0.40, coast ramp 0.20. Torque converter: stall 2000 rpm, 2.0× at stall, couples 1:1 from 2400 rpm (class-typical for the gearbox). Clutch capacity 1.60 × peak torque = 660 N·m. Shift time 0.40 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3.06 | 10.47 | 61 |
| 2 | 1.63 | 5.57 | 114 |
| 3 | 1.00 | 3.42 | 186 |
| 4 | 0.70 | 2.39 | 266 |

Final drive 3.42, reverse 2.29. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.338 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.28 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 492 kg | 1.30 Hz | 32800 N/m | 2250 N·s/m | 3380 N·s/m | 0.20 m |
| Rear | 364 kg | 1.45 Hz | 30200 N/m | 1860 N·s/m | 2790 N·s/m | 0.21 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 4.2°/g with 65% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.452 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 113373 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 40741 F / 37948 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **13300 F / 700 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 4.2°/g, front share 65%. Bump stops 220000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -0.3° F / +0.0° R, toe +0.10° F / +0.00° R (+ = in), caster 3.5°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 302 mm disc, pistons per side 72 mm → A = 40.7 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 126 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·40.7 cm²·0.126 m = **4104 N·m**
- Rear: 279 mm leading/trailing drum, wheel cylinder 23.8 mm → A = 4.45 cm², drum radius 140 mm, brake factor 1.8 (includes lining μ): T = BF·p·A·r = **1117 N·m**

ABS ceiling: caliper capacity 4104 / 1117 N·m exceeds 1.5 × the front lock torque on this car's tire (peak μ 1.14), which `wp_vehicle`'s ABS cannot modulate (it releases to a fraction of the commanded torque, so an oversized caliper keeps the wheel locked). Both axles scaled by 0.97 → **3970 / 1080 N·m**. Remove when 02's ABS modulates relative to lock torque.

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 2324 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.71×), rear needs 776 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.39×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 1326 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity is below that (hardware-limited rear), so `bias_front` = **0.5**: both axles get full caliper torque → delivered 3970 N·m front / 1080 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 1120 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 15.5:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 12.4 m → outer-front path radius 6.09 m, rear-axle-centre radius 4.56 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.566 rad (32.4°)** (outer 28.4°, inner 37.5° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.70). Rack speed 1.1 rad/s.
